assumptions.statement: The organiser has not published precise official redlines or key-area polygons in the public site package. Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, existing-building conditions, heritage constraints, transport, municipal utilities, fire safety and engineering conditions must be confirmed before professional or statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package is reviewable as a conceptual formal AI submission using explicitly provisional geometry. Its areas and ratios are reproducible submission-layer calculations only; placement, dimensions, controls and all precision-sensitive metrics must be recalculated when official data is issued.

assumptions.statement: OpenStreetMap is used only as a visible orientation base in proposal figures.
assumptions.impact: It cannot support redline, ownership, statutory control, existing-condition certification or area metrics; © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL.

assumptions.statement: Nine east-west civic interfaces are conceptual collaboration directions rather than surveyed roads, bridges or tunnels.
assumptions.impact: Their exact position, crossing form, capacity and feasibility require transport, rail, ownership and utility studies.

assumptions.statement: The 3 m Information Platform bay is a reversible test length, not an engineering module or procurement dimension.
assumptions.impact: Structure, fire, waterproofing, energy, lighting, acoustics, foundations and dismantling require site-specific specialist design.

assumptions.statement: The proposed 1.8 m ordinary-route clear width is a participant design target pending full accessibility and crowd-flow design.
assumptions.impact: The final accessible route must follow applicable standards, surveyed constraints and professional review; this value is not a certification.

assumptions.statement: All RACI roles are suggested institutional functions; no named body is represented as having accepted responsibility.
assumptions.impact: G0 must obtain authorised owners before any prototype, data processing or public operation.

assumptions.statement: The V12 expert-reading boards show planning allowances of CNY 0.8-1.5 million for the first 100 days and CNY 4-8 million for three reversible pilots. These are order-of-magnitude design assumptions, not quotations, approved budgets, procurement limits or commitments.
assumptions.impact: A quantity survey, confirmed scope, tax treatment, site conditions, capital and operating budgets, staffing, maintenance, complaint handling, shutdown and restoration must be separately priced and approved before procurement.

assumptions.statement: Public rights and sector tests are participant-proposed release criteria rather than proof of public consent, legal compliance or professional certification.
assumptions.impact: Each pilot requires real users, qualified reviewers, documented failures and an authorised continue/modify/exit decision.

assumptions.statement: The eight personas are qualitative design lenses assembled from task requirements and public-space failure risks; they are not a demographic survey or population share estimate.
assumptions.impact: G0-G1 must use accessible, voluntary field interviews and observed ordinary-route tasks to confirm, split or retire these lenses before pilot release.

assumptions.statement: The 84 tabletop cases are a Cartesian product of twelve conceptual scenarios and seven submitted decision branches, not observed users or field outcomes.
assumptions.impact: Passing proves only rule closure. Site safety, accessibility, legality, effectiveness, public acceptance and recovery performance require authorised field review.

assumptions.statement: The four design roots, three topology boxes, five locks and 48 fixtures are participant-authored design computation. Civic Interlocking is an urban-design analogy, not railway signalling engineering, field operation or safety certification.
assumptions.impact: The results can compare design logic and failure closure only. G0 must replace normalized dimensions and synthetic fixtures with surveyed conditions, authorised owners, professional review and public testing before any physical or digital pilot.

assumptions.statement: Summer shade and winter unshadowed ratios are calculated from proposed route and structure-shadow intervals in normalized prototype boxes.
assumptions.impact: They exclude real sun paths, tree growth, sky view, reflection, wind, heat, weather and surrounding buildings. They support alternative comparison only and cannot demonstrate daylight, microclimate or thermal-comfort compliance.

assumptions.statement: The owner, operator, professional reviewer and public-panel roles shown in implementation cards are proposed functions only.
assumptions.impact: No organisation is represented as having accepted work, budget, liability or decision authority; G0 must obtain written authorisation and a named human owner for each pilot.

assumptions.statement: Heritage, planning, rail-interface, fire, accessibility, utility, data, event and temporary-structure approvals have not been determined for the proposed sites.
assumptions.impact: The approval list is a due-diligence checklist rather than a permit conclusion; unresolved constraints relocate, redesign or cancel the affected component.

assumptions.statement: The three photorealistic key-area scenes are AI-assisted participant visualisations produced to communicate intended experience and material character.
assumptions.impact: They are not photographs, surveyed existing conditions, organiser material, official planning drawings, approved designs or evidence for dimensions and quantities; the source-backed plans, metrics and registers govern.
